notes.title: Change Log as of : June 28 2021 ( Vr. 1.0.5.0 )
notes.content:
We are always working to make our game better, we really hope this update will bring a smoother experience... Hope you will all enjoy!
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

1. A lot of minor bug fixed...

2. Changed some texts & corrected some incoherence...

3. New savepoint in the sewer just before the boss so you don't have to travel back to school to save!

4. Ammo and medkit in boss area... Some may appear only if you are out of that said ammo...

5. Hospital front door key is now on the same floor so you don't have to go trough the sewer again...

6. Further improvements to overall game stability and other minor adjustments have been made to enhance the user experience...

notes.title: Change Log as of : December 19 2018
notes.content:
Vr. 1.0.4.1

The Deluxe Edition of the game is now out!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33271878/8c8cac80deee7ddddd2d055ba589aec7e8fd2a04.png

Shadow Fear™ Deluxe Edition includes:

1. Shadow Fear™ Path to Insanity ( Main Game )
2. The Chapter 0 DLC ( Chapter 0 : The first Night & The Horde Mode )
3. The Bonus Content ( OST, Concept & Artworks, Golden Coin Guide )

The Bonus Content is also available to purchase separately...

notes.title: Change Log as of : November 2 2018
notes.content:
Vr. 1.0.4.1

notes.title: Change Log as of : November 1 2018
notes.content:
Vr. 1.0.4

1. There is now 4 ending possible for the game depending
on some action done by the player.

2. Fixed some visual glitch here and there.

notes.title: Change Log as of : October 25 2018
notes.content:
Vr. 1.0.3

1. New animation for the weapon when being attacked.

2. New weapon animation when player is idle.

3. Grammar correction.

4. A lot of bug fixed!

5. Reworked a lot of puzzle for them to be clearer.

6. Modified some of the default texture to new custom one.

7. Overall stability have been enhanced.

notes.title: Change Log as of : September 18 2018
notes.content:
1. New animation have been added when starting a new game after selecting a game mode. 

2. There is now a message showing what the power-up bonus do at the start of the first wave in the horde mode DLC.

3. You can now see what chest you already opened on your map in the horde mode DLC.

4. Fixed some bug in the main game and chapter 0 DLC.

5. You can now see the version number of the game on the main title screen.

6. Overall stability have been enhanced.

notes.title: Change Log as of : September 6 2018
notes.content:
1. Added a complete new game mode for the Chapter 0 DLC called Arcade Style Horde Mode! Try to survive 5 wave of madness! Each wave are 3 minutes long!

2. Added 3 bonus power up in the horde mode. They are called : Boost Bonus, Ghost Bonus and Coins Bonus!

3. Added 2 end bonus in the horde mode if you have the rank A and S!

4. Fixed some bugs in the main story game.

5. Overall stability improvement.

notes.title: Change Log as of : August 21 2018
notes.content:
1. Added a tutorial for the first key item of the game.

2. Added a shining particle in the first plant with a text saying that the player should search in every plants because there seem to be some hidden items inside of them. ( Not available in survival mode. )

3. The computer with the option to disable the footsteps sound effects is reach much earlier in the game.

notes.title: Change Log as of : August 20 2018
notes.content:
We are working hard the get the game the most perfect possible before the official release this Halloween! Hope you will all enjoy!
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

1. Instant HUD load after map transition drastically upgrading the loading time.

2. The old 5 stage Png Boss Life HUD been upgraded to 18 Png stage. ( Boss HP is more accurate. )

3. Death and game over are now instant and working as intended.

4. Bloods generated when attacking or been attacked are now less cartoony and are not stuck anymore when the pause menu is triggered.

5. There is now footsteps sound effect in the game. ( Normal, Grass, Rock, Wood )( Both normal speed and Adrenaline speed have been included. )( They can be disabled when you reach a certain point in the game. )

6. 3/4 of the inspectable in the game now block the HP regeneration as intended.

7. Various sound effects have been added to make the game more complete. ( including new one for all the boss’s. )

8. HP deduction when getting attacked is now instant for more accurate results.

9. Various handcrafted or modded 3D assets have been included in the game to make the interaction more user friendly and realistic.

10. There is now an tutorial in the mansion hall for the save laptop the first time you enter the map.

11. There is now an Wall Board that show your golden coins and achievements progression in each room where you can save. ( all beside the Mansion Kitchen F1. )

12. There is now NPC hidden in the game with various dialogue.

13. The adrenaline is now obtained a little more late in the game for added challenge.

14. The Chapter 0 DLC is now fully made and playable.

15. Added a lot more new furniture where some map looked empty.

16. You now have an light hallow and downgraded vision when entering the forest part of the game matching the need to obtain the lantern.

17. There is now an additional way to put water in the second jar and an new shortcut have been added to the second half of the game.

18. There is now additional stuff added to the intro of the game. ( mostly cosmetics. )

19. Further improvements to overall game stability and other minor adjustments have been made to enhance the user experience.

20. More game mechanics and enhancements are going to be added if smile game builder updates are worth the update.
